title: Wishbone and spire structures on lunar far side as ancient ruins
place_text: Far side of the Moon, Paris Sea and other craters

tellings.quote: this for example this wishbone structure some spire structures as well. There are structures in Parisa sea and other crater on the uh backside or far side of the moon that also have unusually precise geometries.

plain: On the far side of the Moon, in a lunar sea he calls the Paris Sea and in other craters, there are a "wishbone structure" and "spire structures" with "unusually precise geometries," according to a guest named Maaneli Derakhshani. He describes them on the show without naming a source for the images. If they are what he suggests, they would be the ruins of something built on the Moon long ago.
